label: Three-quarter accuracy on a finite binary benchmark
definition: A method clears a supplied nonempty list when its binary answer is correct at at least three quarters of the entries, counting repetitions. The threshold is an analyst selection.
note: This score encodes no sampling process, admissibility of comparison states, transfer to other states, infallibility or epistemic warrant. A suitably chosen test and a basis for applying its threshold to actual reasoning remain open.
